'''Multi-optic sights''' were pieces of optical enhancement technology that could be attached to any [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. They allowed the user to see in the dark or through smoke via [[Night vision/Legends|night vision]], thermal imaging or ultrasonic sensors. Models included [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [[480.x1 multi-optic sight]], [[Galactic Arms]]'s [[Model 44 combat optical enhancer]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[XAD Omnisight]].
